name: RIT - Caterlink Delivery Invoice → Asset Update

nodes.name: Receive Delivery Invoice Email
nodes.notes: Polls every minute for emails with attachments. No sender or subject filter.

nodes.name: Select PDF Attachment
nodes.notes: Takes the first PDF attachment. No PDF = no output, so the email is ignored.

nodes.name: Parse Invoice PDF
nodes.notes: Reads PO, invoice number, date and line items from the PDF text. Throws if the PO or line items are missing.

nodes.name: Save Execution Data
nodes.notes: Saves the PO number against the execution so it is searchable.

nodes.name: Raise Error
nodes.notes: Fails the run so the shared Error Workflow emails the team.

nodes.name: Anything To Update?
nodes.notes: TRUE = every matching asset (same contract + name) already has a delivery date, so skip to the next line item. FALSE = at least one still needs updating (or no match, which Select Asset To Update will error on).

nodes.name: Any Failures?
nodes.notes: TRUE = every matching asset (same contract + name) already has a delivery date, so skip to the next line item. FALSE = at least one still needs updating (or no match, which Select Asset To Update will error on).
